title: Be Ready for Tax Time All Year
summary: Log receipts and card activity as they happen so your books and tax worksheets are current every week, not rebuilt in a panic once a year.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you do your own books today; the value is time saved and fewer lost receipts, not new income.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: No more paying for a rushed catch-up before the tax deadline.
Fewer missed deductions from lost receipts.

stack.name: Small Business Bookkeeper

stack.name: Receipt Scanner / Expense Tracking
stack.role: Turns forwarded receipt emails and photos into line items with the files saved.

stack.name: Watchdog Receipts

steps.name: Small Business Bookkeeper
steps.does: Enters items and updates tax worksheets

outputs: Tax worksheets ready for your accountant

steps: Pick one inbox or folder for receipts.
Let the receipt bots log what arrives each day.
Have the bookkeeper enter business items and update the tax worksheets.
Review a sample each week and send the worksheets to your accountant.
guardrails: Nothing is paid or filed without your approval.
This is admin help, not tax or financial advice; your accountant has the final word.
